# Braids - Risk-calibrated engineering for AI coding agents

Braids is a portable Agent Skills methodology that keeps simple code changes simple and gives risky changes the care and evidence they deserve. It runs inside the user's coding agent.

## Key Features
- Risk-calibrated depth: Guides agents from D0 to D4 based on consequence, uncertainty, and recoverability.
- Local method: Braids has no remote service, mandatory MCP server, production telemetry, or hidden project state. The host's own policies still apply.
- User-selected effort: Low, high, and ultra thresholds control implementation effort without weakening evidence claims.
- Depth Levels: Ranging from D0 (local, reversible) to D4 (hard to recover, mission-critical).
- Dedicated Skills:
  - `/braids`: Right-size and implement, holding all claims to concrete evidence.
  - `/braids-review`: Engineering review of a diff or PR.
  - `/braids-audit`: Whole repository audit, ranked strictly by consequence and exposure.
  - `/braids-risk`: Adversarial pre-mortem.
  - `/braids-claims`: Maps subjective claims to factual evidence.
  - `/braids-depth`: Set the engineering threshold explicitly.

## Installation
- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add vyas-devgna/braids`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/vyas-devgna/braids && codex plugin add braids@braids --json`
- OpenCode / Cline / Copilot / Windsurf: `npx github:vyas-devgna/braids <host>`
